findings.issue: Zero test files despite a fully wired test setup (vitest + jsdom devDeps, tsconfig.spec.json, "ng test" script); `npm run test` in app/ runs nothing and passes vacuously.
findings.suggestion: Write unit specs for format.ts and catalog.service.ts first (pure, high-leverage), then component/routing tests for home-page and pokemon-page filter/sort/URL-state behaviour.

findings.issue: optional() maps every error (including 500s and network failures) to null, so API outages render as "Not found" pages with no error state; no test would catch a regression here or the conflation itself.
findings.suggestion: Map only 404 to null and let other errors surface (retry or an error view), and add a test asserting a 500 is not treated as missing.

findings.issue: URL-state contract is untested: parseQuery's NaN/negative page handling, param omission at defaults, page reset on filter change, and clamping of out-of-range ?page= values.
findings.suggestion: Add routing tests driving the component through Router: load /?type=fire&generation=generation-i&page=99, change filters, assert URL and rendered slice.

findings.issue: Move-table logic untested: method priority order, Level column only on level-up, nulls-last in both sort directions, default level-then-name sort, and the toggleSort/aria-sort wiring.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test buildTables/compareRows against fixture data including null power/accuracy and multiple methods; a render test asserting aria-sort after two clicks.

findings.issue: The alternate-form cutoff (id <= 10000) is duplicated in three files (also type-page.ts:74 and move-page.ts:63) with no shared constant and no test; changing one copy silently diverges the lists.
findings.suggestion: Extract one isAlternateForm()/SPECIES_ID_LIMIT helper and test it plus the resulting cross-indexes (typeByPokemonId, generationBySpeciesId).

findings.issue: Evolution tree is rendered via recursive ngTemplateOutlet with track child.species.name; branching chains (Eevee) and any duplicate-name collision are untested.
findings.suggestion: Add a component test with a branching chain fixture asserting nested list structure and per-species links.

findings.issue: In-memory response cache (path-keyed, shareReplay refCount:false) is untested; a refactor that keys by full URL or drops replay would duplicate or stale-serve requests unnoticed.
findings.suggestion: Add a test with an HttpTestingController/interceptor counting requests for the same path.

findings.issue: Pure helpers (latestEnglishFlavor's last-English-entry rule, whitespace collapse, em-dash displayValue, humanize) are the cheapest tests in the codebase and none exist; a regression to first-entry flavor text would ship silently.
findings.suggestion: Straightforward vitest specs against these five functions with PokeAPI-shaped fixtures.

findings.issue: parseQuery casts ParamMap `as unknown as Map<string,string>` to duck-type get(); the type-system workaround is exactly the kind of thing a test would have pinned down and possibly forced a cleaner signature.
findings.suggestion: Type the helper against ParamMap (or plain Params) and cover it with unit tests for absent/NaN/page=0 params.

findings.issue: Document-title effects (en-dash format, "Not found – Pokédex" fallback, home reset) are untested; a title regression breaks an explicitly specified behaviour.
findings.suggestion: Add title assertions to page-level component tests (Title service is trivially assertable).

summary: The agent scaffolded a complete test setup (vitest, jsdom, tsconfig.spec.json, ng test script) but wrote zero tests, so all quality gates live in the acceptance suite. The code under it is dense in exactly the logic that regresses silently: URL-synced filtering and pagination, multi-table sorting with a subtle nulls-last rule, cross-indexed catalog maps, and error handling that conflates 404 with server failure. Once someone refactors the data layer, there is no net at all.
